scripts.plugins:import: npm run plugins:env -- run cli -- php wp-content/plugins/plugin-directory/bin/import-plugin.php --create --plugin
scripts.plugins:refresh: npm run plugins:env -- run cli -- wp option delete wporg_env_imported && npm run plugins:env -- run cli wp eval-file wp-content/env-bin/import-plugins.php
scripts.plugins:test: npm run plugins:test:env -- start && npm run plugins:test:env -- run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/plugin-directory phpunit
scripts.themes:import: npm run themes:env -- run cli -- wp eval-file wp-content/env-bin/import-themes.php --user=wordpressdotorg
scripts.themes:refresh: npm run themes:env -- run cli -- wp option delete wporg_themes_env_imported && npm run themes:env -- run cli -- wp eval-file wp-content/env-bin/import-themes.php --user=wordpressdotorg
scripts.themes:test: npm run themes:test:env -- start && npm run themes:test:env -- run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/theme-directory phpunit
scripts.translate:import: npm run translate:env -- run cli -- wp eval-file wp-content/env-bin/import-from-wporg.php
scripts.translate:refresh: npm run translate:env -- run cli -- wp option delete wporg_translate_env_seeded
scripts.translate:test: npm run translate:test:env -- start && npm run translate:test:env -- run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wporg-gp-translation-events phpunit
